background_story: In a mystical realm, Joaquin was a gentle carpophore, a creature with the body of a deer and the antlers of an elk, but with a unique gift - his antlers bore fruit. The fruit was said to have healing properties, and Joaquin roamed the forest, sharing his bounty with those in need. As he wandered, his antlers would bloom with vibrant colors, signaling the ripeness of the fruit. The creatures of the forest would gather around him, and Joaquin would gently pluck the fruit, distributing it among the crowd. His selfless nature and dedication to nourishing others earned him the title of Guardian of the Forest. The ancient trees whispered stories of Joaquin's kindness, and his legend grew, inspiring generations of forest dwellers to follow in his footsteps.
